svg.title: Offset of the largest daily GPP change from the recorded date of each harvest, cut, grazing, tillage and sowing episode, per site. Filled markers are clear change points; grey markers show the offset to the other date of the same event in another source.
svg.desc: Strip plot. X axis: detected day minus recorded date (days, -15 to +45; negative = the flux changed before the recorded date). One row per site; the row label gives the clear and the searched episodes. Marker shape = episode kind (circle harvest or cut, square grazing, triangle tillage, diamond sowing with a GPP rise); open = not clear. Harvest or cut: 23 clear of 33 searched, mean offset −2.0 d, SD 3.7, median 0.0 d, 95 % CI −3.5 to −0.6; 10 before, 9 on and 4 after the recorded date. Grazing: 5 clear of 5 searched, mean offset 2.8 d, SD 6.6, median 1.0 d, 95 % CI −2.2 to 8.0; 2 before, 0 on and 3 after the recorded date. Tillage: 8 clear of 13 searched, mean offset −0.1 d, SD 1.9, median 0.0 d, 95 % CI −1.4 to 1.0; 4 before, 0 on and 4 after the recorded date. Sowing: 2 clear of 3 searched, mean offset 16.5 d, SD 13.4, median 16.5 d, range 7 to 26; 0 before, 0 on and 2 after the recorded date. Grey pairs (other date in a source): Anttila harvest 2022-08-08 0 d / 2022-09-08 −31 d; Qvidja harvest 2018-09-23 +1 d / 2018-09-25 −1 d; Qvidja harvest 2019-06-11 +1 d / 2019-06-10 +2 d; Qvidja harvest 2019-08-20 −2 d / 2019-08-21 −3 d; Qvidja harvest 2020-06-23 +1 d / 2020-06-11 +13 d; Qvidja harvest 2020-08-28 0 d / 2020-08-27 +1 d; Qvidja harvest 2021-06-14 0 d / 2021-06-21 −7 d; Qvidja grazing 2021-08-23 +11 d / 2021-06-01 +94 d; Qvidja grazing 2022-08-05 +8 d / 2022-06-01 +73 d; Viikki tillage 2022-11-01 −9 d / 2022-11-02 −10 d. Offsets beyond the axis are drawn at the edge with their value. Not drawn: anttila-2021-06-03 (no data), anttila-2021-08-02 (no data), sarkisuo-2021-06-09 (no data), sarkisuo-2023-06-29 (no data), qvidja-2018-09-03 (overlap).
